svg.title: AtmosMesh Room perfboard planning drawing
svg.desc: Front component view, mirrored back copper view, and readable wiring diagram for the provisional 31 by 27 hole AtmosMesh Room perfboard.
svg.text: PLANNING DRAWING — DO NOT ENERGISE. Dry-fit the Ideaspark board first; row spacing must be exactly 10 pitches.
Component-side coordinates are authoritative. The copper view is deliberately mirrored. Check every connector by printed pin name.
LEFT EDGE IS C31, NOT C1

g.text: Do not count from this side.
1. Power removed; both 5 V jumpers open.
2. No solder bridges between adjacent pads.
4. Check every route end by pin name.
These colored lines are route corridors,
not an exact hole-to-hole solder map.
The logical diagram below is the

svg.text: READABLE WIRING DIAGRAM — NETS AND PROTECTION
Connector labels are listed in physical pin order. “OPEN” means no shunt fitted.
Before power: no 5 V continuity to 3V3 or any GPIO; verify SDS011 printed connector labels; confirm 3V3 and 5V rails with a meter.
Every capacitor is wired directly across its named local supply and GND. Keep leads short.
Electrolytics C2/C5/C6: positive lead to the named rail, negative stripe to GND. Ceramics C1/C3/C4/C7 are non-polarized.
